labels.label: N4:M3-theta
labels.notes: Pseudo-label (NOTES-3+1.md l.344-349, real-angle half of (M3); the holonomy half hol(C-) = hol(C+) is T-3p1-theorem-m's N4:M3 and is not claimed here). Signature of GX.DSAnnulus.theta_eq_of_regular, by #check: M any (SO0(1,2), HS2)-manifold, A : DSAnnulus M, hreg (every point of the cover is a de Sitter point or a photon), and two real angles theta_m, theta_p of C-, C+; conclusion theta_m = theta_p. No IsIotaPrime, no hepsilon, no LocPathConnectedSpace or SemilocallySimplyConnected argument (both are derived from the HS2 charts). So « no named hypothesis » is true. hreg is N4's « de Sitter annulus », not an added hypothesis. DSAnnulus is a faithful reading of N4 l.323-328 and weaker than it. A genuine closed annulus Abar in Reg Sigma, with C- = bd D- made of past photons (bdMinus) and C+ = bd D+ of future photons (bdPlus), gives a DSAnnulus: its universal covering by the strip R x [-1,1], of period 1, restricts on R x {+-1} to periodic coverings of C+-. The cover is not required to be an embedding, the discs D+- do not enter, and ellipticity is not used, so the Lean statement is at least the paper's. The angles are HasRealAngle for IsPhotonCircle.rp1ChartedSpace, the strict structure from the hyperbolic side (OQ-117 (c), disclosed). HasRealAngle is unique and exists for every circle (GX.HasRealAngle.unique, GX.exists_hasRealAngle), so hm and hp are always satisfiable, and the conclusion is not vacuous. Non-vacuity of the structure: GX.modelAnnulus (dS2 u bdH2+- in HS2) with modelAnnulus_region and modelAnnulus_theta_eq, at Theta = 2 pi with trivial annulus holonomy. That is the only exhibited instance; it suffices, since the theorem is proved for all instances. « Degree included »: N4 takes C- elliptic (l.341-342), so Theta- > 0, and GX.DSAnnulus.hasLiftedHolonomy_iff_of_pos and remark_projIso_of_pos give equal lifted holonomies and a projective isomorphism with no hypothesis. Under N4's own setting the real-angle half of (M3) is therefore proved in full, modulo the two disclosed readings. Status partial (for the readings) and unmarked is conservative and correct.

labels.label: bbsrem:causally_regular_hs_sphere_containing
labels.notes: colI_v1.tex l.3013-3016; no proof environment follows (ledger proof: null). Under the named hypothesis, GX.DSAnnulus.IsIotaPrime.exists_projIso concludes: there is a homeomorphism iota : C- -> C+ with iota (E- s) = E+ (iota' (s,-1)), a (PSL(2,R), RP1)-morphism with an inverse that is one too. That is « iota'_L : C~- -> C~+ induces a projective isomorphism », for every Theta and for either foliation epsilon. IsIotaPrime faithfully weakens l.2991-3004. Its fields: dev is a developing map (IsDevelopment, into the strip model of dS~2 u R+-, checked against GX.dsCover and GX.iotaChart, where the leaves are the vertical segments and R- -> R+ is the identity in RP~1-coordinates); iota' is continuous; it descends (cover z = cover z' -> E+ (iota' z) = E+ (iota' z'), i.e. it lifts a map Abar -> C+, which the paper's construction gives because iota'_L is the lift of the leaf projection of D); and comm: dev o rPlus o iota' = iotaTilde o dev, the diagram of l.2999-3003. Properness and the submersion property are dropped, so the hypothesis is implied by the paper's construction and the conclusion is at least the remark under it. It is satisfiable: GX.modelAnnulus_isIotaPrime with dev = id, iota' = Prod.fst. Without IsIotaPrime, for Theta- > 0, GX.DSAnnulus.remark_projIso_of_pos proves that a projective isomorphism C- = C+ exists. It does not state that this isomorphism is induced by a given map: the inducing map is discarded (minor finding 2). The Sigma hypotheses (causally regular HS-sphere, only elliptic singularities) are weakened to any HS-surface carrying the annulus. The case Theta = 0 without IsIotaPrime is open and disclosed (SCOPE (d)). Partial and unmarked is correct.

findings.what: The checklist row « `A` regular, joining `C₋ = ∂D₋` to `C₊ = ∂D₊` (N4 l.326–328) | ✓ carried » overstates. The discs D± and the relation C± = ∂D± do not enter the Lean: C± are only past and future photon circles joined by the strip. REPORT.json itself lists « D+- discs carrying the particles: weakened, not used ». The error is in the safe direction (Lean assumes less), but a ✓ there is not true.
findings.fix: Mark the row ⚠ weakened (C± need not bound discs; D± do not enter), or add a row for the discs D± as REPORT.json has.

findings.what: Docstring l.66 says the named hypothesis is needed « for the remark when `Θ = 0` only », and l.27 says « `ῑ` induced by `(d|C̃₊)⁻¹ ∘ d|C̃₋`, which is `ι'_L` read in `d̃S² ∪ R±` ». The statements of IsDevelopment.exists_projIso_of_pos and remark_projIso_of_pos certify less: that some projective isomorphism C₋ ≅ C₊ exists. The inducing map is discarded (`obtain ⟨ι, -, hι, hι'⟩` at l.882). « ι'_L induces ῑ » is certified only under IsIotaPrime (exists_projIso), for every Θ. The claim that d₊⁻¹ ∘ d₋ is ι'_L is true (forced by dev_comp and injective_plus) but is not stated in Lean. REPORT.json's second finding for the remark (« (d|C~+)^-1 o d|C~- induces the projective isomorphism … In developed coordinates this map is iota'_L ») carries the same gap. The row is partial and unmarked, so there is no marking error.
findings.fix: Keep the clause `∀ s, ι (A.eMinus s) = A.ePlus (φ s)` with φ = e.symm ∘ D₋ in exists_projIso_of_pos and remark_projIso_of_pos. Optionally add `IsIotaPrime → ι' ∘ rMinus = φ` (from dev_comp and injective_plus). Reword l.66 as: the existence of ῑ needs no hypothesis when Θ₋ > 0; that ι'_L induces it is stated under IsIotaPrime.

findings_checked: « Θ₋ = Θ₊ does not need ι'_L »: true. theta_eq_of_regular's proof and statement contain no IsIotaPrime. It goes through exists_isDevelopment (gx's developing theorem plus lifts) and exists_gTilde_of_holonomy (one h ∈ G̃ on R₋ and R₊, by iota_smul and smul_rp1ToBdPlus). This is an observation about N4's proof route, not an error of the paper.

« degree included » for Θ > 0, and h versus h⁻¹ possible in the formal setting at Θ = 0: accurate as a statement about what is formalized. Auditor's reasoning [r], not checked in Lean, for the master's Θ = 0 question. For an embedded annulus, dev is a local homeomorphism of the closed strip that preserves R₋ and R₊, so D₋ and D₊ have the same monotonicity and h⁻¹ does not arise. For parabolic h it cannot arise even in the general DSAnnulus: a degree-0 lift of a parabolic moves every non-fixed point the same way. So the « quarter turn » case of SCOPE (d) is hyperbolic only, where h and h⁻¹ are conjugate (cf. GX.GTilde.IsHyperbolic.exists_conj_inv in the parallel HSSingularities.lean). The sketch is consistent.

« the remark has no proof of its own; the deck-commutation step is implicit »: true. colI_v1.tex l.3013-3017 is followed directly by a defi (ledger proof: null). The step is closed by IsIotaPrime.apply_add_one (descends, continuity, apply_rPlus).

« l.3006 (d|C̃₊ a homeomorphism) proved in general »: true as stated in the REPORT, for any RP1-circle whose developing lift is equivariant under a fixed-point-free g. Surjectivity comes from surjective_of_equivariant, injectivity from injective_of_isOpenMap_real.
Typos: l.3000 reads `\tilde D\cup\tilde C_-\cup\tilde C@>d>>`, missing the `_+`. l.3002 reads `\tilde R_+` where R₊ (l.2980-2981, l.2988) is already the line ≅ ℝP̃¹. Both are real and minor.
questions_assessed: DSAnnulus reading of N4's data: sound, and weaker than N4 (see the label notes). The master may put it to the author as a reading, with the remark that the generality (non-embedded covers) is exactly what costs equal lifted holonomies at Θ = 0.
Θ = 0 as a target: well posed. See findings_checked item 2 for the hyperbolic-only shape of the opposite-orientation case.
